segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the renewal and the seat add before I send the order form. You’re currently at 42 seats through August 31, and you’d like 58 seats starting September 1, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. Forty-two today, add 16 for the operations supervisors. We need them live for the September 9 training, so September 1 start is good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. The renewal would run September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. Pricing is $74 per seat per month for the 58 seats, billed annually. That totals $51,504 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had from your note. Can you keep the invoice split by location? We need 31 seats billed to Portland and 27 to Boise.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do that. The billing tool will show two line items on one invoice: Portland at $27,528 and Boise at $23,976. Net 30 terms, same as this year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Legal already reviewed the standard terms last year, so no changes from us unless the data processing exhibit changed.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No changes to that exhibit. I’ll attach the current copy with the order form just so procurement has the full packet.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. For onboarding those new supervisors, can we get the admin session on September 3, maybe 11 Central?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, September 3 at 11 Central works. I’ll include that in the kickoff notes, and you’ll get a calendar hold after signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If it lands today, I can get signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the seat count, invoice split, and September 3 admin session included.
